records.text: Erika Kirk was slated to appear with Vice President J.D. Vance at the University of Georgia and completely no-showed the event.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: So last night, in case you missed it, in case you've been hiding under a rock, Erika Kirk was slated to appear alongside her friend, Vice President J.D. Vance, at the University of Georgia, and she just completely no-showed it.

verification.notes: The vice-presidential pool report confirms that Erika Kirk was scheduled to appear with JD Vance at the University of Georgia event and that Andrew Kolvet appeared instead.

records.text: The U.S. Secret Service determined there were no credible threats to the Turning Point USA rally at the University of Georgia; the site was secure and there were no known threats to JD Vance.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep 1mYNOqzAdXs)

appearances.snippet: the u.s secret service determined there were no credible threats to tuesday's turning point usa rally at the university of georgia even as a planned co-appearance by Erika Kirk was canceled over unspecified security concerns. A person familiar with the matter tells CBS News, according to the source, that the site was secure and there were no known threats to the protectee.

verification.notes: CBS News reported, from a person familiar with the matter, that the Secret Service found no credible threat tied to the UGA venue or JD Vance, that the site was secure, and that there were no known threats to the protectee. This verifies the statement as a report of the determination, with medium confidence because the underlying source was anonymous rather than an on-record Secret Service release.

sources.title: Secret Service determines no credible threats to UGA rally after Erika Kirk cancellation, source says
sources.relevance: Reports the Secret Service threat assessment, secure site, and absence of known threats to JD Vance.

records.text: Turning Point USA ignored a school's security concerns about placing Charlie Kirk in an uncontrolled traffic area.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: They ignored the security concerns that were expressed by the school that they shouldn't do this in an uncontrolled area for Charlie (Charlie Kirk). or uncontrolled traffic area they put him there like a sitting duck

verification.notes: The episode makes the accusation, but live searches found no school statement, security plan, correspondence, or named witness establishing that school officials warned TPUSA against an uncontrolled traffic area and were ignored. Unable to verify from current public sources.

records.text: Candace Owens said Erika Kirk abandoned a University of Georgia appearance after warnings about low attendance, and Owens accused Turning Point USA of falsely blaming death threats afterward.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: when you walked in tonight, I was on the phone with actually the president of the University of Georgia and she up in this sort of sorry for the Turning Point USA chapter and there had just been this situation where. ... Erika (Erika Kirk) wasn't going because the crowd size and she said that was it. It was the crowd size. ... We told them that it wasn't going to be a big crowd. We were concerned the entire time. We had communicated this to them that people didn't want to go. ... And then Erika (Erika Kirk) abandons that commitment in the last moment and they get on stage and they blame the world. ... It's like you didn't show up for your commitment and now you're telling the world that she had death attacks or like, you know, death threats and that wasn't true.

verification.notes: Kirk did cancel the UGA appearance, the event drew a visibly small crowd, and CBS reported that the Secret Service found no specific or credible threat tied to the venue or protectee. However, TPUSA said its concern involved travel outside the secured perimeter, and CBS reported that hostile or threatening messages may have existed. The cancellation and low-attendance context are supported, but the categorical accusation that the threat explanation was false is not established.
